description.value: Mid Island Liquor is a liquor retail store located in Duncan on Cowichan Lake Road, serving the mid-Island region of Vancouver Island. As a stop on routes through the Cowichan Valley, it offers touring cyclists a convenient place to pick up beverages. The shop is situated in a unit within a commercial complex near Duncan.
